==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. Using my portal spell, I sent Golem Planet to an empty dimension. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (Porta is my portal spell.) (The empty dimension resembles glowing iridescent geometries.)
Village King fears that The Endless may one day rule over the Golem Planet and find a way to return. (Village King resembles a giant, wooden, elf man who wears a green robe with a white fur collar.) (The Endless is the English translation of the Death Demon's true name. The Death Demon is a demonic treefolk with an aura of purple energy.)
I use my creation spell to form a magical hero academy in the village, to help give the Village King more peace of mind. (My creation spell is Fingo.) (The Magic Hero Academy resembles three towers of white stone in a row, with the center tower being taller than the other two adjacent towers.)
